adopted_p1_boundaries: M143r2 zero-duration PWP/correction endpoints are not RTL-equivalent to M142; a minimum endpoint floor is mandatory.
M142 bank plus 16-bit tag completion identity admits ABA, SEQUENCE_BITS=18 wrap misorders the oldest selector, and exact relative row order is not enforced.
M142 omits SRAM/engine work length and the 160 outer barrier/commit operations, so M143r2 remains a same-clock Python module model rather than RTL cycle evidence.

closure_route.rtl: M144r2 exact relative rows, 32-bit sequence echo, sequence-checked completions, and one outer barrier/commit fence
closure_route.cycle_model: M143r3 must include minimum endpoint floors and explicit barrier/commit cost
closure_route.remaining: SRAM macros, engine arithmetic/service measurements, routed timing, and activity power remain outside M144r2
